worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.summar: A dish of electricity opens around the user: every enemy inside takes one bolt, and a share of each hit is drawn back - the more targets, the more healing.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.use.0: Catch a whole ring and drain it back when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.use.1: Sustain that heals more the more foes are in the dish
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.use.2: Press everyone nearby at once in a scrum
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.descri: Opens an electric dish centred on the user; every enemy inside takes one bolt, up to %3$s targets. Each bolt deals about %1$s special damage, of which %2$s is drawn back to the user - one share per target caught.
Dish radius %1$s blocks (also the real range).
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.wide.o: Wide dish: dish x1.25, more targets drawn in, but each bolt x0.82.
Focused: dish x0.78, each bolt x1.28 and heavier - for few, hard targets.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.timing: Opens a %1$s block dish centred on the user; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP; recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.growth: From level %1$s each bolt rises to %2$s and the dish widens to %3$s blocks.
From level %1$s each bolt rises to %2$s, the drain share to %3$s, and the dish to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.paraboliccharge.prefer: On: dish x1.25, more targets drawn in at once, but each bolt x0.82 - heals through numbers. Off (focused): dish x0.78, each bolt x1.28 and heavier.
Beyond this distance the user closes in rather than opening the dish. Larger opens from further away.
When on, the user prioritises the dish when 2 or more electrically valid enemies stand inside its own dish; when off it only ranks by ordinary attack order.
Below this health ratio the user prefers parabolic charge as sustain; higher leans on it for healing sooner.
